name: Android
title: Your privacy, ready for the everyday.
lead: Protect the connection on the phone that goes everywhere with you, from everyday browsing to public Wi-Fi.
description: The Traverse Android app brings VPN protection to your mobile connection. Connect through an encrypted tunnel, mask your regular IP, and use available privacy features from one app.
imageAlt: Phone user on a city street after dark

highlights.title: One-tap connection
highlights.text: Open the app, choose a server, and connect before using a shared or unfamiliar network.

highlights.title: Mobile-friendly safeguards
highlights.text: Options such as kill switch and auto-connect can help keep protection aligned with your routine.

highlights.title: Choose app routing
highlights.text: Split tunneling can let you choose which apps use the VPN connection.

steps.title: Choose a plan
steps.text: Pick the plan that works for your needs.

steps.title: Install Traverse VPN
steps.text: Find the official Traverse VPN app for Android and sign in.

steps.title: Connect and browse
steps.text: Choose a server or connect quickly, then use the internet with your VPN active.

detailsTitle: Designed to travel with your phone

details.title: Public Wi-Fi protection
details.text: Add an encrypted layer when you join Wi-Fi in cafés, hotels, or airports.

details.title: App-based routing
details.text: Choose which apps go through the VPN with split tunneling, when available.

details.title: Stay connected
details.text: Traverse lists auto-connect and kill switch among the Android features on its product page.

details.title: Use across devices
details.text: Your account can be used on other supported devices too; check the current plan for device limits.

compatibility: Other supported devices under one account
note: Android features and supported versions may vary by device and app release. Check the current store listing.
